get_card.description: Look one Pokemon card up by its TCGdex id, such as swsh3-136: the set id, a hyphen and the number printed on the card. Returns everything on it: category, HP, types, stage, attacks, abilities, weaknesses, resistances, retreat cost, rarity, illustrator, regulation mark, legality, variants, image addresses and a price summary, in any of 18 languages. No account or API key required.

search_cards.description: Search every Pokemon card by name, category, type, rarity, set, series, illustrator, stage, suffix, trainer or energy type, what it evolves from, Pokedex number, HP range, retreat cost or regulation mark, then sort and page the result. Each card comes back in brief: id, number, name, set and image addresses; pass the id to Get a card for the full record. Leave every filter blank to page through the whole database. No account or API key required.

parameters.description: Optional. The card name, or part of one, such as Pikachu or Charizard ex. Matched regardless of case unless Name match is set to Is exactly.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Optional. How the name is matched: contains (the default), starts with, ends with, or is exactly. Contains, starts with and ends with ignore case; is exactly matches the name as printed, so Furret finds the Furret cards and furret finds none.
parameters.name: name_match

parameters.description: Optional. Only Pokemon, Trainer or Energy cards.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Optional. Only Pokemon of this type, such as Fire or Water. A card with two types matches either.
parameters.name: pokemon_type

parameters.description: Optional. Only cards of this rarity, spelled as TCGdex does: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Rare Holo, Ultra Rare, Illustration rare, One Diamond and so on. List card field values gives every rarity.
parameters.name: rarity

parameters.description: Optional. Only cards from this set, chosen from the list or typed as its id, such as swsh3.
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.description: Optional. Only sets or cards of this series, chosen from the list or typed as its id, such as swsh or tcgp for Pokemon TCG Pocket.
parameters.name: serie_id

parameters.description: Optional. Only cards by this illustrator, spelled as TCGdex credits them, such as Ken Sugimori or Mitsuhiro Arita.

parameters.description: Optional. Only Pokemon with this suffix after the name, such as ex, GX or V.
parameters.name: suffix

parameters.description: Optional. Only Trainer cards of this kind: Item, Supporter, Stadium, Tool and so on.
parameters.name: trainer_type

parameters.description: Optional. Only Energy cards of this kind: Normal (basic energy) or Special.
parameters.name: energy_type

parameters.description: Optional. Only Pokemon that evolve from this one, such as Sentret to find every Furret.
parameters.name: evolves_from

parameters.description: Optional. Only cards of the Pokemon with this National Pokedex number, such as 25 for Pikachu.

parameters.description: Optional. Only Pokemon with at least this many HP.

parameters.description: Optional. Only Pokemon with exactly this retreat cost.

parameters.description: Optional. Only cards with this regulation mark, the letter in the bottom corner that decides Standard legality, such as G or H.

parameters.description: Optional. Leave out the cards TCGdex has no image of yet, for a workflow that posts the picture.

parameters.description: Optional. How to order the cards: by id, by number in the set or by name. Leave blank for the database's own order, which is by number within each set.

parameters.description: Optional. Which way to order the list. Only applies alongside Sort by.

parameters.description: Optional. Which page of the result to return. Defaults to the first; the result's next_page says which to ask for next.

description: Look up Pokemon Trading Card Game cards, sets and series on TCGdex, the open card database: get any card with its attacks, abilities, rarity, legality, prices and image, search cards by name, type, HP, set, rarity or illustrator, list every set and series, read Cardmarket and TCGplayer prices, and draw a random card. Covers every set from Base Set to Pokemon TCG Pocket, in 18 languages. No account or API key required.
